acceptance_rule: Candidate prompt/response must match the indexed source row and segment text must reconstruct the source response after whitespace normalization.
strict_quality_rule: Scores in [0.01, 1.0], unique ranks exactly 1..N, unique scores, and scores strictly decrease as ranks worsen. Invalid sides were repaired deterministically using their numeric score signal; strict original sides were preserved exactly.

method.description: Repair invalid sides only; preserve strict sides byte/deep-equivalently. Numeric scores determine descending rank order; existing rank breaks score ties and orders nonnumeric-score segments. Scores are clipped and strictly separated only when the original score signal is not already valid.
method.model: deterministic local repair (GPT Luna agent specification; no external API calls)

invariants: chosen and rejected segment text reconstructs the original response after whitespace normalization
every side has numeric value_score in [0.01, 1.0]
every side has unique ranks exactly 1..N
every side has unique scores strictly decreasing by rank
strict original sides are deep-equal unchanged
invalid original sides change only rank/value_score
all non-segment fields are deep-equal unchanged

semantic_rerank.model: GPT-5.6 Terra agent (direct semantic review; no randomized assignment)
semantic_rerank.method: Direct prompt-conditioned reread of each flagged response side, preserving the original segmentation. Explicit segment priority orders were assigned under the original side-specific rubric; unique monotonic scores were then attached to those reviewed ranks. No randomness used.

invariants: only rank and value_score changed on the five target sides
the opposite side in every target row is deep-equal unchanged
segment text, segment order, segment counts, and every non-score/rank field are unchanged
all 15,782 sides reconstruct their source response after whitespace normalization
all chosen and rejected sides have scores in [0.01, 1], unique ranks exactly 1..N, unique scores, and scores strictly decreasing by rank
